name: 08_general
topic: Real-time bus tracking — never miss your bus again
headline: Real-Time Bus Tracking
supporting_text: Know exactly when your bus arrives

brief.objective: Position Trackin as the essential real-time bus tracking app that eliminates wait-time uncertainty and empowers commuters to plan their day around transit.
brief.audience: Urban commuters aged 18–45 who use public transit daily, value reliability, and expect seamless digital experiences.
brief.marketing_angle: Focus on the emotional relief of knowing exactly when your bus arrives, turning unpredictable transit into a predictable, stress-free part of your routine.
brief.key_message: Never waste a minute wondering where your bus is — Trackin gives you live, accurate arrival times so you can take control of your commute.
brief.tone: Professional yet approachable, confident in data accuracy without being overly technical, and directly addressing commuter pain points.
brief.visual_direction: Clean, modern UI with vibrant amber or electric blue accents against a light background, featuring dynamic map interfaces and simple, bold typography that highlights countdowns and route clarity.

bible.mood: Confident, clear, and empowering — a feeling of control and reliability, with a human touch that reassures commuters.
bible.typography: Inter: headings 48px Extra Bold (light bg) or 40px Bold (dark sections), body 16px Regular with 1.5 line-height, buttons 14px Semi-Bold, countdowns 56px Extra Bold in primary color.
bible.composition: Clean, left-aligned layouts with generous negative space, placing key data (like countdowns or route maps) in the upper-left focal zone. Secondary info aligns to bottom or right. Use soft diagonals or slight perspective to imply movement.
bible.lighting: Soft, even illumination with a warm amber glow from the accent color highlighting key elements (e.g., bus location). No harsh shadows; slight gradient fade on primary elements for depth.
bible.texture: Smooth, almost flat with very subtle grain (0.5% noise) to mimic high-end digital motion. Buttons and cards have a gentle 1px white border for definition.
bible.background_description: A dynamic abstract scene: layered blue gradient waves against a pale cyan base, with thin white grid lines suggesting a digital map. In the top left, a soft amber light source (like sunrise) casts a subtle glow, while the lower right has a faint, blurred silhouette of a modern city skyline under a clear sky.
